why: Dry Creek's Farm is the abandoned protein farmstead east of Yucca where Jackie Welles waits with the smuggled iguana in The Nomad. Its shell, storage shack, TV, radio and loose loot are in always-streamed world sectors, so free roam already has the empty farm; vanilla only ever stages Jackie and the prologue's chase agents there. This proposal deliberately restores no people and no prefabs: the site stays the abandoned, accessible farmstead it is, while the meeting tableau, the cargo, Jackie's old car, the q003 noise and the quest vista toggle are excluded.

open_questions: Drive south from the SoCal Border Crossing and confirm a player can reach Dry Creek's Farm in free roam. Vanilla seals the checkpoint and kills anyone who tries to pass; the farm's map pin (-3239, -6737) is about 1.15 km south of the checkpoint (-2836, -5663), so this may be a tour-only venue unless the border opens.

Walk the farmyard and into the storage shack where Jackie waits in vanilla, and confirm the shed, TV and radio all stream without #q000_nomad_pr_protein_farm. The gameplay, devices and loot refs are in the always-streamed exterior_-51_-106_1_0 sector while only the camp and triggers are in quest_2aa9d17bde3f9140, so the shell should be there.

Turn on the TV and use the radio in the shack and confirm both still interact. They are ordinary devices in the farm's always-loaded devices section, and q003's TV actions (which name the same #tv_1_q003) never run.

Check that the farm is empty of prologue props: no Jackie, no old car, no iguana crate, no meeting-point trigger firing and no Arasaka chase agents. The chase agents' community lives on the AV-chase route, not at the farm.

Open the storage-shack door in free roam with no quest running. The catalogue knows no DoorControllerPS at the farm, so the runtime door policy will not touch it and it must be an ordinary interactive door.

deferred_prefab_owner: world streaming (the chosen people need no quest prefab)

tour_stop.source: {q000_mp_protein_farm_meeting} map-pin marker in always_loaded_0.streamingsector (dist/extract/markers.jsonl); the farm's refs sit in exterior_-51_-106_1_0 and quest_2aa9d17bde3f9140 (scene marker q000_sm_nomad_04_drive_to_border is 1.7 m away at -3240.81, -6742.75). Verification stop only: the site has no people, so an EMPTY scan is the expected result; the tour is there to confirm the shed, TV and radio stream without the quest prefab and that Jackie's camp props are absent.

proximity_wait.why: The TV in the farm's devices section is the one real device entity at this venue; its full $/ path is used because every TV in the city carries the node name #tv_1_q003 (the neighbouring meat factory has eleven of them). It sits in the always-streamed gameplay/devices prefab, so it is present before any proximity branch could run. This venue activates nobody, so the anchor only gives the builder a physical marker and the tour a landing point.
